enforced_by: the copywriter and the video teardown read it; nothing refuses an unknown value
note: One list per dial — humour, delivery style, register, pacing, reference world, avoid; the asset is the dial.

rows.name: laugh-at
rows.what: The comedians, creators and formats this room actually laughs at.

extra.when: Read for TIMING and CADENCE — where the beat sits, how long the pause runs, how the joke is set up. Used to set the humor dial, never to write a line.

rows.name: trust
rows.what: The creators, experts and peers this room believes when it believes anyone.

extra.when: Read for the SHAPE of trusted delivery — how they open, whether they hedge, whether they show or tell. Used to set the delivery style.

rows.name: watch
rows.what: The shows, channels and content formats this room watches without being sold to.

extra.when: Read for FORMAT — the host medium the piece has to stop looking like an ad inside.

rows.name: quote
rows.what: The lines, catchphrases and running jokes this room repeats to each other.

extra.when: Read for register and in-words — what the room sounds like when it is talking to itself.

rows.name: look
rows.what: The visual world: wardrobe, setting, the objects around, the actual state of the room.

extra.when: Read for WHAT IS IN FRAME — styling, location, props.

rows.name: sound
rows.what: The sound world: what is playing, what the room sounds like, what a person there would have on in the background.

extra.when: Read for the bed, the room tone and what the piece must NOT sound like.
